answer: A superlinear slashing matrix S(k)=k^α (α>1) applied to staked collateral C penalizes any Sybil coalition of size n by n^α·C. The protocol binds a zero‑knowledge verifiable delay function (falcon) to a time‑locked anchor, forcing an adversary to commit before proposing blocks so that expected utility U = p·R − (1−p)·n^α·C stays negative for any p<1. Choosing delta beyond the maximal rational deviation horizon yields a subgame‑perfect Nash equilibrium where honest staking dominates and attack incentives vanish.
